definitions.explanation: A large green or brown grasshopper (the migratory locust) common in Japanese fields, known for its strong jumping and long flights. Also written {殿様飛蝗|とのさまばった}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{原|はら}っぱ→原っぱ：30132_harappa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧トノサマバッタ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捕|つか}まえた→捕まえる：01214_tsukamaeru⟧。
examples.english: I caught a migratory locust in the field.

examples.japanese: トノサマバッタ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{遠|とお}く⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{飛|と}ぶ→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧。
examples.english: Migratory locusts fly well over long distances.

examples.japanese: トノサマバッタ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦バッタ→バッタ：06515_batta⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{特|とく}に→特に：01260_tokuni⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{種類|しゅるい}→種類：01560_shurui⟧だ。
examples.english: The migratory locust is an especially large kind of grasshopper among those in Japan.

notes:
The migratory locust, one of the largest and most familiar grasshoppers in Japan. The name literally means 'lord grasshopper' (⟦{殿様|とのさま}→殿様：10455_tonosama⟧ + ⟦バッタ→バッタ：06515_batta⟧), reflecting its impressive size.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- トノサマバッタ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捕|つか}まえる→捕まえる：01214_tsukamaeru⟧: to catch a migratory locust
- トノサマバッタ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{飛|と}ぶ→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧: a migratory locust flies

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦バッタ→バッタ：06515_batta⟧: grasshopper — the general term; トノサマバッタ is one particular species
- ⟦イナゴ→イナゴ：25812_inago⟧: rice grasshopper — a smaller relative traditionally eaten in some regions
